# Public contribution checklist

- [ ] This change stays within the public repository scope: documentation, issue templates, release information, or public project metadata.
- [ ] This change does not include App Doctor product source code, private validation artifacts, generated binaries, secrets, credentials, or sensitive application data.
- [ ] I checked `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `SECURITY.md`, and `KNOWN_ISSUES.md` where relevant.

## What changed

Describe the public-facing change.

## Why

Explain the problem this change solves or the clarification it adds.

## Validation

Describe how you checked the change.
